title: The open-unit isomorphism on finite-Tor ring stages
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a finite-field datum $D$ with $\ell\ne D.p$, finite-type $D.k$-schemes $X,Y$, and a separated finite-type $D.k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$. Use the finite and completed integral ring stages $s$ and their full finite-Tor inclusions $I_{X,s}$ [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data, def-sf-constructible-exceptional-assembly-data]. Given compactifications $c,d$ of $f$ and a proper refinement $r:c\to d$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], the coefficient pullbacks along $j_cr=j_d$ and $rp_d=p_c$ have their canonical composition identifications. There is a natural isomorphism $\epsilon_s:I_{X,s}j_{d,!}\simeq I_{X,s}j_{c,!}Rr_*$. At every input $K$, its transpose under $j_{d,!}\dashv j_d^*$, followed by the pullback-composition/proper-counit restriction $j_d^*Rr_*j_{c,!}I_{X,s}K\to j_c^*j_{c,!}I_{X,s}K$, is the open unit at $I_{X,s}K$. The explicit word from $I_{X,s}Rp_{c,*}j_{c,!}$ to $I_{X,s}Rp_{d,*}j_{d,!}$, obtained by the inverse proper compositor and $Rp_{d,*}(\epsilon_s^{-1})$, commutes with the inherited integer shifts. No exceptional operations, adjunction refinements, or coefficient-extension squares are part of the conclusion.

proof.text: The canonical coefficient identifications compose: for a finite ring apply constant-section pullback coherence, and for integral coefficients apply completedPull_comp. These supply hi and hg.

Use the explicit ambient refinementOpenMap. Whisker with the full finite-Tor inclusion. Its components are invertible by ringOpenMap_isIso, so asIso gives a natural isomorphism epsilon. The already proved refinementOpenMap_normalization is precisely the required transpose equation.

The open map and proper compositor commute with their ordinary integer shifts. Write properOpenRefinementWord as whiskered inverse proper composition, associators, and the proper image of epsilon inverse. This is equality with the actual component formula. Every factor commutes with shifts, proving the required CommShift property.

theorem exists_ring_open_refinement
  (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
  {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
  [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
  [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    {c d : Compactification f} (r : c.Refinement d)
    (s : RingStage.{max u v} l) :
    ∃ (hi : (s.coefficients l).pull (c.i ≫ r.hom) =
        proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i r.hom
          ((s.coefficients l).ring d.Z) ((s.coefficients l).ring c.Z)
          ((s.coefficients l).ring X)
          ((s.coefficients l).pull r.hom) ((s.coefficients l).pull c.i))
      (hg : (s.coefficients l).pull (r.hom ≫ d.g) =
        proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients r.hom d.g
          ((s.coefficients l).ring Y) ((s.coefficients l).ring d.Z)
          ((s.coefficients l).ring c.Z)
          ((s.coefficients l).pull d.g) ((s.coefficients l).pull r.hom))
      (ε : RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s ⋙
          (PurCompactSupport.openExtension (s.coefficients l) d.i).mapDerivedCategory ≅
        RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s ⋙
          ((PurCompactSupport.openExtension (s.coefficients l) c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
            PurCompactSupport.push (s.coefficients l) r.hom)),
      (∀ K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (s.stage l),
        (PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction (s.coefficients l) d.i).homEquiv _ _
            (ε.hom.app K) ≫
            PurCompactSupport.refinementRestriction (s.coefficients l) r hi
              ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K) =
          (PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction (s.coefficients l) c.i).unit.app
            ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K)) ∧
        (ringRefinementWord.{u, v} l Ω r s hg ε).hom.CommShift ℤ
